features.quote: Classes with Arnaud DJBN, Ichigo, Manu & Olivia
features.rationale: Dance classes with named teachers are part of the event.
Afternoon socials are scheduled each day.
The event has three separate dance rooms.
A dress code theme is explicitly stated.
The full pass price includes accommodation.

features.quote: with breakfasts included in rooms for 2 or 10 people
features.rationale: Breakfasts are included with the accommodation package.

features.quote: Shuttles will be provided for festival-goers arriving by train or plane on Friday and Sunday.
features.rationale: Shuttle transfers from train and plane are provided.
